subject: Fiscal Year 2018 Budget Approval
overview: The Council approved the $167 million municipal budget for fiscal year 2018 and authorized various end-of-year transfers to cover departmental deficits. Members also discussed neighborhood impacts of a major Eversource utility project and postponed a decision on funding for square beautification.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2017 End of Year Transfers
items.summary: Approved various end-of-year transfers for fiscal year 2017, including over $886,000 to cover snow and ice deficits, following a failed motion to sever funds from public safety and auditorium accounts for maintenance needs.

items.title: Square Beautification Appropriations
items.summary: Tabled a request to appropriate $250,000 from free cash for beautification projects across five city squares pending a Committee of the Whole meeting to review specific project goals with business owners.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2018 Budget Approval
items.summary: Approved the $167,117,437 city budget for fiscal year 2018, which includes funding for a new recreation department, a traffic engineer, and expanded vocational programs in schools.

items.title: Ultimate Tango Sign Permit Petition
items.summary: Referred a petition to reverse a sign permit denial to the Subcommittee on Economic Development and Signs for further review of historical aesthetic standards.

items.title: Eversource Energy Underground Utility Project
items.summary: Referred a major underground utility project to the Committee of the Whole to address public concerns regarding traffic delays, construction noise, and electromagnetic field exposure.

items.title: Council Resolution Tracking
items.summary: Discussed delays in receiving responses from city departments on various resolutions and reviewed how new software will track legislative handoffs in real time.

items.title: Fire Station Sidewalk Replacement
items.summary: Approved a resolution to replace the crumbling sidewalk in front of the Engine 2 fire station on Harvard Avenue.

items.title: Routine and Memorial Matters
items.summary: Adopted memorial resolutions for several residents and approved the records of the previous meeting.
